When driver is set to enable bb credit recovery
setting as inactive.  If the link bounces
During link up processing
column2: the driver currently does a MBX_READ_SPARAM

column1: followed by a MBX_CONFIG_LINK. These mbox commands are queued to be
executed
column2: one at a time and the completion is processed by the worker

column1: thread.  Since the MBX_READ_SPARAM is done BEFORE the MBX_CONFIG_LINK
BB_SC_N bit is never set the the returned values. BB Credit recovery status
only gets set after the driver requests the feature in CONFIG_LINK
is done after the link up. Thus the ordering of READ_SPARAM needs to follow
the CONFIG_LINK.
Fix by reordering so that READ_SPARAM is done after CONFIG_LINK.  Added a
HBA_DEFER_FLOGI flag so that any FLOGI handling waits until after the
READ_SPARAM is done so that the proper BB credit value is set in the FLOGI
payload.
